trials_and_ci.independence: fresh scenario per trial (new actor session, overlay applied+restored, new run_id); model sampling unseeded
trials_and_ci.pass_at_k: share of cases whose all k scored trials pass; cases with any setup_failed trial leave its denominator until ledger rerun
trials_and_ci.ci95_wilson: per-metric Wilson 95% interval, n = pooled non-null trial observations; exact for binary Pass@1, score-interval approximation for fractional metrics

shopping.quantity_precision_semantics: demand-fill: one satisfying SKU at requested quantity fills quantity slots

precision_ceiling_ratio.precedent: NDCG/IDCG normalization against the achievable ideal
precision_ceiling_ratio.demand_fill_overshoot: capped at 1.0; overshoot stays visible in raw Precision@4

support.must_not_claim_consumed: uncued hit in final answer fails the case
support.forbidden_claims_consumed: verbatim hit in final answer fails the case

handoff_ended_conversation.semantics: a turn ending with an open ticket suspends the conversation; later turns are business-rejected (409 human_control_active), never setup_failed
handoff_ended_conversation.scoring: score from the last completed turn; expected_handoff=true makes the handoff itself the pass, unexpected handoff fails

allow_handoff.semantics: insufficient without ticket and needs_human with persistent ticket are both honest closures (both pass)
allow_handoff.validator_enforced: requires expected_handoff=false and allow_insufficient=true, else AnnotationError
allow_handoff.never_existed_material: insufficient only; handoff stays a fail (over-transfer)

llm_judge.note: Faithfulness 主报为 judge；CLI judge 报告用于抽检复核

faithfulness_judge.judge_failure_policy: Faithfulness=null (missing denominator), never a borrowed rule value

claims_scope.grading_principle_v6_2: essential = removing the proposition from the final answer leaves some actually-asked question unanswered or misleadingly half-answered on the scoring face; everything else genuinely related (background, mechanism, safety rules, procedural detail, follow-up service pointers, earlier-turn recap) is peripheral
operational_clauses: action-request turns: direct denial AND completion-condition/alternative-path are both essential; capability/policy-inquiry turns: only the direct denial/confirmation is essential, later service pointers are peripheral

multi-turn cases anchor on the final turn (including unresolved earlier questions it incorporates by reference); earlier turns reversed or narrowed away by the final turn are peripheral; final-turn self-containment remains an authoring requirement

faithfulness_answer_side.definition: decompose the answer's own statements, verify each against docs (RAGAS-aligned)

attribution_integrity.definition: passed deterministic assertions / total assertions; denominator is assertions, not playbooks

script_playbooks.note: v6.1 additive: mechanism playbooks ads-d-06..11 add assertions on top of the base 8
script_playbooks.exhaustion_semantics: final in-budget click auto-transitions campaign to EXHAUSTED/budget_exhausted; later ops 409 ads_not_active and the campaign leaves delivery candidates

headline_revision_v6.reason: 名实对齐与正规化，非刷分：导购 P@4 换 NDCG 式贴满率（同槽位同分母，仅除以可达 ceiling，raw P@4 与 ceiling 保留诊断列）；广告公开分从模拟 CTR/CVR（确定性校验伪装成效果比率）改为归因完整性（断言级分母），CTR/CVR 降为诊断列。
